name: Utilization Rate
description: Calculate utilization as actual output over maximum possible output.
formula: Utilization = Actual Output / Maximum Possible Output
business_contexts: a factory assessing utilization of its production line
a hotel assessing utilization of available rooms
a call center assessing utilization of available agent hours
a hospital assessing utilization of available beds
a warehouse assessing utilization of available storage capacity
question_patterns: Given the actual output and maximum possible output below, what is the utilization rate?
Calculate the utilization rate from the figures given.
What percentage of capacity is being used, given the figures below?
Calculate utilization by dividing actual output by maximum output given.
Using the figures below, what is the utilization rate?
solution_logic: Step 1: Calculate utilization rate = actual_output / maximum_output
key_insight: Utilization can never exceed 100% by definition — actual output is always bounded by the maximum the system can physically produce.
common_mistakes: Dividing maximum output by actual output instead of the other way around
Reporting a utilization rate above 100%, which signals the maximum figure was misread
framework_soundbite: Utilization is actual over maximum — it can approach 100% but never pass it.
